title: Solanaceous Section
organization: Zimbabwe Department of Research and Specialist Services

chunks.content: The Zimbabwe Department of Research and Specialist Services describes drip irrigation as a way to apply water close to tomato plants and advises avoiding waterlogged conditions. The page does not provide a forecast-based irrigation rule or current field-specific water amounts. Use this only as general crop-management context; do not infer an irrigation schedule without the farmer's soil, crop stage, and irrigation setup. Older pesticide references on this page were not included.
